about: The people the owner names who may send requests from /send/ (site/policy/abp.json site_requests): a label and the public halves of the key on their QR code. The keeper issued each key in its session (tools/person-key.mjs) and holds the private half too, so it can read what is sealed to that person; a new keeper session issues new keys. Names are published only with the person's agreement.
